# chameleon_schedules (Data Source)

List schedules visible to the caller, optionally filtered by job_type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All dbt schedules.
data "chameleon_schedules" "dbt_jobs" {
  job_type = "dbt"
}

output "dbt_schedule_summary" {
  value = [
    for s in data.chameleon_schedules.dbt_jobs.schedules : {
      name        = s.name
      cron        = s.cron_expression
      last_status = s.last_status
    }
  ]
}
```
